english.title: Cause use of a vehicle not fitted with an amber warning light
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on an unrestricted dual-carriageway road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle fitted with four or more wheels, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), having a maximum speed not exceeding 25mph, when the vehicle or a trailer drawn by it was not fitted with at least one warning beacon showing an amber light which complied with Schedule 16 to the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
